*   **Current Ratio:**  (Current Assets / Current Liabilities) rose from 4.16 (4484/1075) to 5.55 (6285/1811). This signifies a stronger ability to meet short-term obligations.
*   **Debt-to-Equity Ratio:** Decreased from 3.54 (8575/2411) to 3.37 (10082/2982), indicating a slightly improved capital structure.
